method: Official public websites reviewed for information architecture, buyer task completion, product discovery, proof, localization, mobile hierarchy and conversion patterns. Scores are comparative design scores, not company ratings.

benchmarks.lesson: Deep product taxonomy is paired with applications, industries, success stories, service and local contact.
Search and product access lead; education and engineering support reduce buyer uncertainty.
Corporate authority comes from division structure, technology, sustainability, careers and investor proof.
A large group can stay human and editorial while preserving clear business-area entry points.
Lead with outcomes and markets, then route technical buyers into products, services and support.
Country selection, product search, industries and service access are first-class global navigation tasks.
Products, solutions, support and partner ecosystems should be equally easy to reach.
High-impact industrial imagery works when supported immediately by products, industries and service.
A product-led mega menu, local sales path and service entry are essential for equipment businesses.
Heavy industry benefits from a strong corporate story, innovation evidence and investor-grade facts.
Technical product finders and knowledge resources deserve primary navigation status.
Industry solutions become persuasive when the site shows full lifecycle capability and case evidence.
Contract manufacturers should lead with capabilities, markets, global footprint and measurable scale.
End-to-end value-chain messaging works when each promise links to a concrete capability page.
Brand storytelling, dealer access, product ecosystems and investor trust can coexist without a generic hero.
Segment products by buyer job, then reinforce with technology, service and ownership support.
Dense technical catalogs remain usable through disciplined categories, search, documents and support.
A conservative global brand can build trust with disciplined hierarchy, local gateways and restrained motion.
Technical resources, product search, lifecycle services and direct sales contact form one conversion system.
Sustainability messaging is credible when connected to product engineering and specific applications.

cross_site_findings: The homepage is a routing layer, not a poster; product, capability, industry and support paths appear within the first two viewports.
Strong manufacturing sites separate products, applications and industries instead of mixing them into generic cards.
Search, downloads, local contact and service are persistent buyer utilities.
Proof is distributed: quality, locations, case studies, process, scale, news and governance each answer a different risk question.
The best sites use large industrial imagery but keep it subordinate to product discovery and evidence.
Country and language selection is part of the commercial architecture, not a footer afterthought.
Mobile navigation prioritizes product finders, contact and search rather than copying every desktop item.
A complete factory site needs distinct page types for capabilities, products, industries, quality, downloads, careers and RFQ.
